item.title: Katy Perry, LISA, Anitta & More at 2026 World Cup USA Opening Ceremony: Best Moments From Inside L.A. Stadium
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host's energetic voice takes over]
Host: "Welcome to the FIFA World Cup USA Opening Ceremony recap. On Friday night, June 12th, the Los Angeles Stadium, also known as SoFi Stadium, was electric as Katy Perry headlined the show, representing all the California Gurls out there. She was joined by an incredible global lineup of artists, including LISA, Anitta, Tyla, Rema, Future, Dan + Shay, and Purahei Soul.
[Short music clip of "Game Time" plays in the background]
Host: "The night kicked off 90 minutes before the game with Future and Tyla performing their World Cup song, 'Game Time.' Then, LISA, Anitta, and Rema took the stage with another track from the official World Cup album, 'Goals.' After a short break, Katy Perry brought the house down with her 2024 hit 'Wonder,' surrounded by flags from every country participating in the World Cup this year. And, in a special moment, 10-year-old Norwegian singer Tius Luka joined her on stage.
[Short music clip of "The Star-Spangled Banner" plays in the background]
Host: "As the game approached, Purahei Soul performed the Paraguayan national anthem, while country duo Dan + Shay sang 'The Star-Spangled Banner' to get the crowd ready. And, in the end, the U.S. Men's National Team took down Paraguay 4-1 in their opening match. Their next game is against Australia on June 19th.
[Short music clip of a World Cup song plays in the background]
Host: "This was the final of three opening ceremonies for the 2026 World Cup. Earlier, Shakira and other artists performed in Mexico City, and Alanis Morissette and friends took the stage in Toronto. Tyla was the only artist to perform at multiple ceremonies, and Shakira is set to headline the World Cup Final halftime show alongside BTS and Madonna. What a night it was! We'll be back with more updates from the World Cup. Thanks for tuning in!"
[Upbeat music fades back in, and the host's voice disappears]
